note: The promoted 4-bit/group-64 proposal head and its six BF16 Q/K/V precision-island tensors are preserved tensor-for-tensor. Two additional bare BF16 tensors provide a rank-8 token-conditioned correction inside the proposal-only compact draft selector; every unsupervised conditioning-token and output row is exactly zero. The adapter changes only which token the MTP side proposes; the target model, exact target top-2, emitted-token decision, cache journal, rollback, and trusted serial replay are unchanged. Missing, disabled, malformed, unsupported, or full-vocabulary paths retain the incumbent selector. The artifact is immutable-revision and runner-tree-digest pinned; no remote code is executed.
